verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents webhooks that send signed HTTPS requests on repository or organization events such as pushes, new issues and merged pull requests. These could be routed to a chat tool, but only through a custom relay or receiver. The evidence shows no native chat-tool integration. Missing for 10: first-party Slack/Discord/Teams integrations, chat-formatted notification delivery, configurable notification subscriptions to channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
